name: Spellcasting
description: You can cast Druid spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You know 2 cantrips and have 4 prepared level-1 spells; you can replace one prepared spell whenever you gain a Druid level. You can use a Druidic Focus as your spellcasting focus.

name: Druidic
description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids, and you always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can use Druidic to leave hidden messages: others who know Druidic spot them automatically; anyone else needs a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to spot one and magic to decipher it.

name: Primal Order
description: You have dedicated yourself to a sacred role of your choice. Magician: you know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list, and you gain a bonus to Intelligence (Arcana or Nature) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Warden: trained for battle, you gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.
